input.quote: 10.5 DISCLAIMER OF WARRANTIES. EXCEPT FOR THE EXPRESS WARRANTIES SET FORTH HEREIN, NEITHER PARTY MAKES ANY REPRESENTATIONS OR GRANTS ANY WARRANTIES, EXPRESS OR IMPLIED, EITHER IN FACT OR BY OPERATION OF LAW, BY STATUTE OR OTHERWISE, AND EACH PARTY SPECIFICALLY DISCLAIMS ANY OTHER WARRANTIES, WHETHER WRITTEN OR ORAL, OR EXPRESS OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING ANY WARRANTY OF QUALITY, MERCHANTABILITY, OR FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR USE OR PURPOSE
input.rationale: Article 10 contains only Effective-Date representations about corporate status, patents, know-how and regulatory compliance (Sections 10.1 and 10.2) plus covenants (10.3/10.4). Nothing warrants the quality of anything Harpoon delivers or performs: there is no conformance-to-documentation warranty, no warranty period, and no repair, replacement or refund remedy, while Section 10.5 disclaims all warranties other than those expressly given. Section 3.8.4 ('in good scientific manner and in compliance with all Applicable Law') is a mutual performance covenant, not a warranty with a duration and remedy, so the fallback is failed on its material terms. We therefore insert one short fallback-level warranty (90 days software conformance to documentation, 30 days services) with repair/replacement or refund; because the disclaimer is expressly subject to warranties 'SET FORTH HEREIN', no carve-out edit to Section 10.5 is required. We did not pursue the preferred 12-month/no-malicious-code package, which is not proportionate to this development and option agreement.

proposal.summary: Insert a short Harpoon performance warranty (90-day software conformance to documentation, 30-day services warranty) with repair/replacement or refund remedies.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement contains no performance warranty for any software or services Harpoon delivers, and Section 10.5 disclaims everything not expressly warranted. We add a short warranty at our fallback position - 90 days conformance to documentation for software, 30 days for services - with repair, replacement or refund as the remedy.

ops.text: 10.6 Performance Warranty. Harpoon warrants that (a) any software delivered to AbbVie under this Agreement will conform to its documentation for ninety (90) days following delivery, and (b) any services performed by Harpoon under this Agreement will conform to the requirements of this Agreement for thirty (30) days following performance. AbbVie's remedy for breach of this Section 10.6 is repair or replacement of the non-conforming software or re-performance of the non-conforming services, or a refund of the fees paid for such non-conforming software or services.

Services are warranted for at least 30 days.
Warranty remedies include repair or replacement.
